items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are mostly clear, but none of the exported API (Encryptor, Config, LoadKey, DecryptReader) has doc comments. Business logic uses single-letter names (`h`, `k`, `b`). `initErr` holds every later decrypt error, not just init errors, which is misleading.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: decryptReader.Read is about 105 lines and mixes lazy init, header checks, chunk parsing and the HMAC check. LoadKey repeats the same decode-and-length-check block for env/file/literal. The handler calls Validate, then LoadKey validates again.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Errors are wrapped, but LoadKey returns `nil, nil` when `!cfg.Enabled`, which hidden LoadKey tests expose. decodeBase64Key silently accepts 4 encodings, and TestLoadKeyBadBase64Encoding fails. Magic numbers 12/16/32/64*1024 are repeated, and PBKDF2 uses only 4096 iterations.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: fileutil signatures are changed as required. storage.PathGenerator keeps its 2-arg signature and hardcodes `EnsureFileName(filename, gzip, false, unique)` instead of passing encrypt through. Job.Validate now joins all errors instead of returning the first. Unencrypted output is unchanged.

validity_flags.basis: existing test lines changed/removed (4): fileutil/fileutil_test.go; existing test lines changed/removed (2): handler/jobhandler_test.go
